'''Amenohiharaoshinadomi no Kami''' (天日腹大科度美神, アメノヒバラオオシナドミ) is a deity appearing in {{ill|Japanese mythology|en|Japanese mythology|qid=Q814158|lt=Japanese mythology}}.
== Overview ==
Amenohiharaoshinadomi no Kami is mentioned exclusively in the ''{{ill|Kojiki|ace|Kojiki|ar|كوجيكي|az|Kociki|bcl|Kojiki|be|Кодзікі|bg|Коджики|ca|Kojiki|ckb|کۆجیکی|cs|Kodžiki|da|Kojiki|de|Kojiki|eo|Koĝiki|es|Kojiki|et|Kojiki|eu|Kojiki|fa|کوجیکی|fi|Kojiki|fr|Kojiki|gl|Kojiki|he|קוג'יקי|hi|कोजिकी|hr|Kojiki|hu|Kodzsiki|hy|Կոձիկի|id|Kojiki|it|Kojiki|ja|古事記|ka|კოძიკი|kk|Кодзики|kn|ಕೋಜಿಕಿ|ko|고사기|la|Kojiki|lt|Kodžiki|mk|Коџики|ml|കൊജികി|ms|Kojiki|my|ခိုဂျိခိ|nl|Kojiki|no|Kojiki|oc|Kojiki|pl|Kojiki|pt|Kojiki|ro|Kojiki|rsk|Кодїки|ru|Кодзики|sh|Kojiki|simple|Kojiki|sk|Kodžiki|sl|Kodžiki|sr|Коџики|sv|Kojiki|ta|கோஜிகி|th|โคจิกิ|tl|Kojiki|tr|Kojiki|uk|Кодзікі|vi|Cổ sự ký|zh|古事記|zh_classical|古事記|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}}'' as the 14th generation deity of the {{ill|Seventeen Generations of Earthly Deities|ja|十七世神}}. He is a descendant of {{ill|Ōkuninushi|ja|大国主神|qid=Q276944}}.
The name can be interpreted as follows:
- "Ame" (天): Heaven or divine origin.
- "Hi" (日): Sun or spirit.
- "Hara" (腹): Field or plain.
- "Ō" (大): Great or magnificent.
- "Shina" (科): Wind.
- "Domi" (美): Spirit or essence.
The name signifies "a great divine spirit of the wind originating from the sacred heavenly plains."{{Sfn|Nishimiya|2014|p=382}}
== Research and Interpretations ==
Due to its lengthy name, various theories exist regarding its meaning. Some interpret "Hihara" as referring to locations such as Nihara or Hihara, while "Shinado" is seen as either "the source of winds" or "a slope." "Mi" is debated as either denoting femininity or a term of respect. Scholars suggest that this deity, along with others in the lineage, represents a gradual transition from divine to more human-like attributes.{{Sfn|Nishimiya|2014|p=382}}
== Genealogy ==
[[File:Ohokuninushi family tree.png|right|thumb|250px|Genealogy of Ōkuninushi (from the ''Kojiki''). Blue represents male deities, red represents female deities, and yellow represents deities of unknown gender.]]
Amenohiharaoshinadomi no Kami is a descendant of {{ill|Ōkuninushi|ja|大国主神|qid=Q276944}}. His father, {{ill|Nunotomidori Narumi no Kami|ja|布忍富鳥鳴海神}}, is the seventh generation descendant of Ōkuninushi, and his mother is {{ill|Wakajinzume no Kami|ja|若尽女神|qid=Q135330271}}. He marries {{ill|Totsumachine no Kami|ja|遠津待根神|qid=Q135330329}} and has a son, {{ill|Totsuyamasakitarashi no Kami|ja|遠津山岬多良斯神}}.
